# Test: move player UP, see if gray square moves LEFT (90 deg CCW)
def pp(fr):
    bb=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    blue=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if bb[r][c]=='b' and 5<r<60 and c<40]
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in blue)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in blue))
    return (rs[0],rs[-1],cs[0],cs[-1])
def graypos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']>10:
            bnd=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in bnd]; cols=[p[1] for p in bnd]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
print("before: player", pp(current_frame), "gray", graypos(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print("after UP: player", pp(current_frame), "gray", graypos(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
